From 1b9448b071caa7d10bb2569fabe3020a2c25ae59 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2015 11:49:59 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: quirk backlight present on Macbook 4, 1

Unsurprisingly macbooks have backlights, just the VBT doesn't seem to
know it in this case.

Reported-and-tested-by: Daniel Nicoletti <dantti12@gmail.com>
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=88325
Fixes: c675949ec58c ("drm/i915: do not setup backlight if not available according to VBT")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v3.15+
Reviewed-by: Ander Conselvan de Oliveira <conselvan2@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Link: http://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1446716999-1796-1-git-send-email-jani.nikula@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
index b0f23692346e..bcf227356f78 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
@@ -14707,6 +14707,9 @@ static struct intel_quirk intel_quirks[] = {
 	/* Apple Macbook 2,1 (Core 2 T7400) */
 	{ 0x27a2, 0x8086, 0x7270, quirk_backlight_present },
 
+	/* Apple Macbook 4,1 */
+	{ 0x2a02, 0x106b, 0x00a1, quirk_backlight_present },
+
 	/* Toshiba CB35 Chromebook (Celeron 2955U) */
 	{ 0x0a06, 0x1179, 0x0a88, quirk_backlight_present },
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c`**
   - A new entry has been added to the `intel_quirks` array for the Apple Macbook 4,1 model. This entry specifies that the backlight is present for this model, using the `quirk_backlight_present` function.
   - The specific entry added is:
     ```c
     { 0x2a02, 0x106b, 0x00a1, quirk_backlight_present },
     ```

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a bug where the Video BIOS Table (VBT) did not recognize the presence of a backlight on the Macbook 4,1 model. By adding this quirk, the patch ensures that the backlight functionality is correctly enabled for this specific model, aligning with the behavior expected for Macbooks.
- This change is part of a broader effort to fix issues related to backlight management in Intel graphics drivers, as indicated by the reference to a previous commit that disabled backlight setup when not available according to the VBT. The patch is also marked for stable kernel versions, indicating its importance for users on those versions.

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is that the Video BIOS Table (VBT) did not correctly identify the presence of a backlight for the Apple Macbook 4,1 model, leading to the backlight functionality not being set up properly in the graphics driver. This oversight resulted in the backlight being unavailable despite the hardware supporting it.
